depiction.primary_object: four stacked horizontal wavy black lines
depiction.composition: four parallel undulating ribbons stacked vertically, centered

readings.meaning: water / waves / sea / ocean / lake / river

ambiguity: Can be confused with fog/mist weather icons, airflow/ventilation lines, a hamburger menu at very small sizes, or slices of bacon.

go for an open water swim

check river water levels before kayaking

reasoning: Four parallel wavy horizontal bars universally represent water, waves, the sea, or a swimming pool. It fits tasks about open water, tides, surf, pool chemistry, swimming, and water utilities, though at tiny sizes it can resemble a menu icon, fog, or bacon strips.
